questions.q: What is the relationship between json.dumps() and json.loads()?
options: dumps converts Python objects into JSON text; loads converts JSON text back into Python objects — opposite directions
They do exactly the same thing with no difference
dumps only works on numbers; loads only works on strings
Both functions delete data rather than convert it
questions.explain: loads parses text into Python; dumps serializes Python objects back into text.
